subject.title: [Feature]: You are spaming ChatGPT like crazy

question: Should main-session cron systemEvent reminders get a new explicit literal no-model path, or should deterministic scheduled delivery remain limited to command cron?
rationale: The current code intentionally uses heartbeat/model semantics for main-session systemEvents, and changing that behavior affects cron, delivery, session context, and cost policy rather than being a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add a literal reminder mode
options.body: Add a narrow opt-in payload or mode for trusted literal reminder delivery that avoids model calls and leaves existing systemEvent semantics unchanged.

options.title: Use command cron only
options.body: Keep command cron as the supported no-model path and document that main-session systemEvents remain model-mediated heartbeat input.

options.title: Auto-bypass simple systemEvents
options.body: Try to infer simple reminders automatically, accepting higher risk of inconsistent behavior and skipped model handling for ambiguous events.

recommendation.title: Add a literal reminder mode
recommendation.body: Add a narrow opt-in payload or mode for trusted literal reminder delivery that avoids model calls and leaves existing systemEvent semantics unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision sits in heartbeat prompt and cron product semantics where steipete has prior review and implementation history.
